channel.title: Dennis Hilk — Blog (English)
channel.description: Linux, open source, retro computing, weird hardware and personal projects by Dennis Hilk.

item.title: From Arch Linux Minimal to dwm 6.8: My Complete Cthulhu Gaming Desktop
item.description: My real Arch Linux build: Btrfs, systemd-boot, dwm 6.8, Kitty, Fish, Fastfetch, AMD RADV, Steam and OBS using VAAPI AV1 plus working Vulkan game capture.

item.title: NixOS + XMonad: Building My Complete Kanagawa Dragon Desktop from Scratch
item.description: Rebuild my NixOS XMonad desktop with Kanagawa Dragon: Plasma or Minimal, safe startx migration, dual monitors, complete configs, Kitty, GTK and Fastfetch.

item.title: Ubuntu 26.10 OpenSSH Bug: How Package Cleanup Can Break SSH Access
item.description: Ubuntu 26.10 OpenSSH: when purging residual rc packages can break SSH, which versions are fixed, safe checks and console recovery. USN-8928-1 explained separately.

item.title: RAYMOSAIC: Mirror Art and GIFs from Reflected Light
item.description: Create light art with 448, 666 or 1337 calculated mirrors. Explore reflection physics, draw a motif and export clean GIFs locally in your browser.

item.title: Chernobyl Unit 4: RBMK, the Control Room and the SKALA Computer
item.description: Understand Chernobyl Unit 4, RBMK reactor physics, the SKALA process computer and AZ-5 through sourced history and an interactive museum reconstruction.

item.title: Disk 16 Failed: Quake, Nine Inch Nails and the Art of Carrying Data Home
item.description: From Quake and Nine Inch Nails to my Windows 95 handbook and a 128 GB Ventoy stick: a personal history of storage media, with an interactive museum lab.

item.title: IBM Z Meets Arm: Inside the Dual-ISA Mainframe Processor Announced in 2026
item.description: IBM’s 2026 dual-ISA processor announcement explained: eleven cores, native IBM Z and Arm support, teaching instructions and an interactive architecture lab.

item.title: Jurassic Park’s UNIX System Was Real: Silicon Graphics, IRIX and fsn
item.description: Was the UNIX system in Jurassic Park real? Explore SGI Crimson and Indigo hardware, IRIX, the real fsn file browser and my interactive museum reconstruction.

item.title: The Apollo 11 Guidance Computer: How It Helped Land on the Moon
item.description: How did Apollo 11's guidance computer work? Understand AGC specifications, DSKY, Luminary 099 and the 1201/1202 alarms, then try my lunar landing model.

item.title: The IMSAI 8080: The Real Computer Behind WarGames (1983)
item.description: What computer was used in WarGames? Explore the IMSAI 8080, Intel 8080 instructions, binary switches and my interactive museum reconstruction.

item.title: Forgot Your ZIP, RAR, 7Z or PDF Password? Recover Files Locally Without Uploading
item.description: Forgot a ZIP, RAR, 7Z or PDF password? Learn how to recover supported encrypted files locally in your browser, without uploads, using CPU or supported GPU modes.

item.title: How Fast Can Your Computer Crack a Password? CPU vs GPU Explained
item.description: Explore real browser password searches with CPU, WebGPU and Hybrid mode. Understand dictionaries, brute force, measured estimates, Argon2id, MFA and passkeys.

item.title: RX 9060 XT Linux Hardlocks: Mesa 26.2.4 and My Troubleshooting Journey
item.description: RX 9060 XT on Arch: My GEM traces show closed buffer handles before CS rejected (-2). Descriptor-pool stack, capture gaps and five script versions.

item.title: From Slackware in 1996 to NixOS in 2026: My Cthulhu Linux Journey
item.description: From Slackware, OS/2 Warp 4 and SGI to Linux Mint, Gentoo and NixOS: the history of my Cthulhu workstation with original photos and an interactive timeline.

item.title: Darknet Explained: How Tor Works — and Why I Rarely Use It Today
item.description: Understand the darknet, deep web and Tor: onion routing, rendezvous, SecureDrop, Bitcoin and anonymity limits, with an accessible network illustration.

item.title: I Built My Own Cryptocurrency — and Mined It Myself
item.description: From a Moonlander 2 to a Litecoin-based private coin: my 2018–2019 Nebucoin experiment with NOMP, a Qt wallet, staking and an interactive blockchain lab.

item.title: NEBUVERSE: Self-hosting GoToSocial on Debian 13 – my story
item.description: My personal Fediverse instance on Worldnode: GoToSocial 0.22.1, Debian 13, SQLite, nginx, WebFinger, relays, real memory figures and tested Restic backups.

item.title: What Happens When You Open a Website? DNS, TLS, HTTP and the Browser Explained
item.description: Follow a website request from URL and DNS to TCP or QUIC, HTTPS, HTTP and rendering. Explore every step in a privacy-friendly, interactive packet journey.

item.title: Build your own operating system: bootloaders and BoringKernel
item.description: OS development for beginners through BoringOS: Limine, kernel entry, memory management and QEMU. Understand the path from boot to a native desktop.

item.title: Configure Dunst: Linux desktop notifications explained
item.description: Understand Dunst with my Cthulhu colours, notification position, timeouts and rules. Test local notifications and troubleshoot common problems.

item.title: Configure Kitty: fonts, colours, transparency and terminal images
item.description: Configure Kitty step by step with my Gruvnode settings: fonts, colours, transparency and terminal images. Start with a separate local test file.

item.title: Picom on X11: understand transparency, shadows and errors
item.description: Picom for X11 explained using my Gruvnode profile: Kitty transparency, shadows and common errors. Try a separate configuration with a clear way back.

item.title: Configure Rofi: an app launcher, shortcuts and custom themes
item.description: Rofi for beginners: understand drun and run, read my Gruvnode theme and test a separate Rasi file. Includes XMonad shortcuts and troubleshooting.

item.title: fish for beginners: suggestions, aliases and configuration
item.description: Understand the fish shell: suggestions, Tab completion, aliases, abbreviations and config.fish. Includes small exercises linked to my NixOS setup.

item.title: Git pull fails: understand diverging branches, merge and rebase
item.description: Git reports diverging branches? Understand fast-forward, merge and rebase through my server update, including diagnosis, conflicts and recovery.

item.title: journalctl for beginners: find Linux errors in system logs
item.description: Narrow down Linux problems with journalctl: filter by boot, time, service and priority. Includes a local test message and guidance for sharing logs.

item.title: Linux drives explained: UUIDs, mountpoints and permissions
item.description: Understand Linux mounts: UUIDs, mountpoints, ext4 permissions, fstab and NixOS. Includes a read-only exercise and my Games/Homelab configuration.

item.title: Linux framebuffers explained: DOOM on my Cisco phone
item.description: How DOOM runs locally on the Cisco CP-9951: framebuffers, pixel formats, stride and real keys explained, with a small calculation and project links.

item.title: Try Linux in a VM: KVM and virt-manager for beginners
item.description: Try Linux before migrating: understand KVM, QEMU, libvirt and virt-manager. Includes a NixOS example, virtual storage and NAT networking.

item.title: NixOS rollback: understand generations and undo an update
item.description: Understand NixOS generations: boot an older system, roll back with nixos-rebuild and repair your configuration. Cthulhu provides the concrete example.

item.title: Source2Reel: turn a GitHub project into a local explainer video
item.description: My Source2Reel workflow explained: inspect sources, create a storyboard, use local AI and narration, then render with FFmpeg. Cisco DOOM provides the example.

item.title: SSH keys on Linux: connect from your laptop to a server
item.description: Set up SSH keys step by step: Ed25519, public and private keys, ssh-copy-id, server identity checks and a readable client configuration.

item.title: From Azeroth to Linux: Why I've Been Nebu for 20 Years
item.description: From my WoW warlock Nebukatneza through motorcycles, video editing and Linux to my own GoToSocial instance, NEBUVERSE: the story behind the name Nebu.

item.title: Wine prefixes explained: separate Windows environments on Linux
item.description: Wine prefixes for beginners: understand WINEPREFIX, drive_c, registry files and Lutris. Try a separate environment and learn its backup and safety limits.

item.title: Back up Linux configuration: Dotfiles, package lists and data backups
item.description: Plan Linux backups clearly: distinguish dotfiles, package lists, NixOS files and personal data, with Cthulhu examples and practical restore checks.

item.title: Configure Fastfetch: My Cthulhu system overview step by step
item.description: My Fastfetch configuration explained: screenshot, Kitty image logo, Nerd Fonts, JSONC modules, disks and an age counter. Start with a small local test file.

item.title: Configure Waybar: A clear status bar for Sway
item.description: Waybar for beginners: understand my Sway bar, separate JSONC from CSS, preview a small configuration and add a clock, volume and CPU display.

item.title: Gruvnode: My simple XMonad desktop from the T480 to the X1 Carbon
item.description: Gruvnode explained: from a Debian T480 to an Arch X1 Carbon. Understand the installer, XMonad, Xmobar, audio, Wi-Fi, configuration backups and first startup.

item.title: Understand Linux gaming: Steam, Proton, Lutris and MangoHud
item.description: Linux gaming for beginners: understand Steam, Proton, Lutris, GameMode and MangoHud, test one game deliberately and inspect the Linux Gaming Toolkit scope.

item.title: NixOS for beginners: My configuration.nix explained
item.description: Understand NixOS through my configuration.nix: packages, services, Plasma, PipeWire and hardware, with a small change you can build, test and undo.

item.title: Sway for beginners: My Wayland configuration explained
item.description: Learn Sway through my configuration: variables, two monitors, workspaces, keybindings and window rules, with a small change you can validate and undo.

item.title: Understanding XMonad: My xmonad.hs step by step
item.description: Understand my xmonad.hs: the Super key, Tall and Full layouts, keybindings and hooks, then compile, restart and undo a small configuration change.

item.title: SPDIF audio delay on Linux: Why the first sound disappears and what helps
item.description: Missing the first SPDIF sound after an idle period on Linux? Explore suspend, PulseAudio, PipeWire and a local SoX keepalive with the SPDIF-Fix project.

item.title: Switching from Windows to Linux: What to check first
item.description: Plan your Linux migration: check apps, games, hardware, live tests and data transfer with the local-first Linux Migration Companion.

item.title: Convert images without uploading them: JPG, PNG and WebP explained
item.description: Convert and resize JPG, PNG and WebP locally in your browser. Learn about format choice, quality, transparency, metadata and browser support.

item.title: Delete files on Linux: What HDDs, SSDs and TRIM mean for Skynet Shredder
item.description: Understand Skynet Shredder: delete local files and folders on Linux, compare HDD overwriting with SSD TRIM and learn the limits of file deletion.

item.title: Inspect Windows network traffic: Which process connects where?
item.description: Use Windows Telemetry Inspector to investigate Windows 11 network traffic by process, service and DNS – locally, without uploading your capture.

item.title: Install NVIDIA drivers on Debian 12 and 13: APT, CUDA and Secure Boot
item.description: Install NVIDIA drivers on Debian 12 and 13 using APT. Understand Stable, Backports, optional CUDA, kernel headers and Secure Boot with this script.
